issues.issue: ending_cash leaves out the separately printed county treasurer cash 7,105. The project rules treat county treasurer cash as Cash and Cash Equivalents, and the balance sheet records it that way. beginning_cash is null (no prior-year governmental cash printed). Year-to-year: FY2023 ending fund balance 898,716 and business-type net position 857,846 = St_Edward_FY2024 beginning as printed.

Mixed 'grants and contributions' label with no grantor stated (SoA: operating 12,500 for fire/library, capital 5,286 for community building). It is kept with one category under the 2026-11-06 mixed-label ruling, but it could be grants (intergovernmental). The same applies to detail[10]-detail[12].

issues.on_page: Grant and contribution income 10,000 (Water Fund); cash flows p8 'Grant proceeds' 10,000 under capital and related financing
issues.issue: The cash flow statement calls this money 'Grant proceeds', which suggests a government grant (intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants) rather than a private donation. The same applies to detail[92].

The same printed label 'Charges for services' gets Recreation Fees for Park/Pool (detail[7], detail[8]) but charges for services/fees for Community Building (detail[9]) and the statement line receipts[8]. The department-based split is defensible, but it breaks the same-label-same-category check. Community Building charges may be Rentals.
Police contracted services is most of police spending and may be a sheriff/law enforcement contract (detail_category law enforcement contract). The page doesn't say who the contractor is.
